description:
## Original Description
Close the workflow, verification, and environment gaps identified by reviewing sdd-mcp v6.0.0 against the "Let AI Work" five-layer defense pyramid (Structure, Machine Checks, Run & Verify, Minimal Text, Human Review). P0: block record-green after a setup-classified RED; bind RED/GREEN/complete evidence to a working-tree diff hash with RED→GREEN argv continuity and git-checked observed artifacts, surfacing post-verification code drift in status and commit; add a project-configured fixed verification entrypoint, reject inline-eval commands (node -e, python -c) in verified mode, and extend the RED classifier to Python, Go, Rust, JVM, and .NET; enforce typecheck and lint in CI with a no-new-violations strictness ratchet; refresh stale steering. P1: require isolated workspaces plus a hard stop-list and retry budget for parallel implementation; prune Layer 4 rule text, retire non-executable paper hooks, fix stale skill wording and the sdd-jev-check red evidence schema; require honest Unverified/Could-Not-Run reporting; add an environment-correction workflow implementing the four-tier ladder and the two-occurrence rule. P2: skill blind-test harness, optional interface-first or prototype spike in design, and incremental legacy cleanup. Keep human approval gates and token discipline intact, and update all relevant documentation.

## Core Features (What)
All P0 and P1 gaps plus light P2: (1) structural evidence hardening — block GREEN after setup RED, diff-hash binding with RED→GREEN argv continuity, git-checked observed artifacts, post-verification drift in status/commit; (2) fixed verification entrypoint in .spec/sdd-config.json, inline-eval rejection in verified mode, multi-language RED classifier; (3) CI typecheck+lint with a no-new-violations ratchet and refreshed steering; (4) parallel implementation isolation, stop-list and retry budget, Layer 4 rule pruning, paper-hook retirement, stale wording and sdd-jev-check red schema fixes, honest Unverified reporting; (5) a new /sdd-correct skill for the four-tier correction ladder and two-occurrence rule; plus a lightweight skill blind-test rubric and an optional interface-first/prototype spike in sdd-design. P2-3 legacy cleanup (removing root documentGenerator.js/specGenerator.js/atomicWrite.js and the moduleLoader bridge, modularizing the 1,970-line WorkflowEngineService) is deferred to a follow-up feature. Burning down the 324 pre-existing lint warnings, auto-merge, weakening sdd-approve or sdd-review-test-cases human gates, and default verifier subagents are out of scope.

## Success Criteria
Each P0 bypass has an automated test that fails before the change and passes after; CI runs build, typecheck, lint, and test on Linux and macOS; lint introduces zero new warnings versus a committed baseline; documentation-consistency, skill size-budget, render-baseline, and message-contract tests pass; human approval gates behave unchanged.
